description: ChainK9's deepest token check on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc, for bigger buys and due diligence. Everything /scan does (a real buy and sell on a fork of the chain plus 60+ checks: honeypot, changing taxes, owner powers tried for real, limits, cooldowns, liquidity, upgrade authority), plus who holds the token: the largest holder's and the top 10's share of supply, ranked from the token's whole transfer history with the largest balances read on chain, and whether a single wallet holds the pool's liquidity tokens and could pull the liquidity. Holder checks cover tokens with up to about 10,000 transfers (most new launches) and say so when a token has more. A stored ultra result also answers /scan and /report. Not charged when the address isn't a token or has no liquidity yet (422). Costs $0.05 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.
